split_methodology: Grouped K-Fold Template Holdout (1 entire template family held out per class)

held_out_families_by_class.A: The action traces to a workload for which forensic review established an unauthorised change of control
held_out_families_by_class.B: The volume and timing differ from the established baseline and the responsible team has not explained the deviation
held_out_families_by_class.C: The action matches a recurring business transaction in prior reviewed sessions, including its scope and result
held_out_families_by_class.D: The resource owner’s approved operations request <CHG_ID> explicitly covers the action and initiating administrator
held_out_families_by_class.E: The security team’s validation job <SEC_ID> accounts for the observed action and its target scope
held_out_families_by_class.F: An incorrect retry setting caused the action to recur; service traces reproduced the same sequence
held_out_families_by_class.G: Two context sources disagree about workflow attribution and neither can be independently verified
